name: odd fault
description: An unnaturally humanoid-shaped hole, it seems oddly familiar.  You feel a strange urge to examine it closer, as if it belongs to you somehow.

effect.u_message: This wall is perfectly vertical.  Odd, twisted holes are set in it, leading as far back into the solid rock as you can see.  The holes are humanoid in shape, but with long, twisted, distended limbs.
